comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Orchard MRT about 180 m, Orchard Boulevard MRT about 570 m; closer than 491 of 551 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 1,240 m; more than 0 of 551 similar developments (the same as 106). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 11 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 340 m), more than 516 of 551 similar developments (the same as 22); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 1,220 m; nearest park Camp Road Interim Park about 1,100 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 360 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 380 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 570 m; River Green, 34 new sales, about 1,030 m; 21 Anderson, 6 new sales, about 1,070 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 1,270 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 1,310 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 1,360 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 406 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,328 new sales and 1,326 resales (2,654 purchases); new sales were 50% of these purchases. Subsales (32) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,250 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,430 m; upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,890 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,326 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 506 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,326 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,451 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−8.6%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
